source_full_text: It will be a hard enough task as it is, But it will be altogether hopeless if we don't stick together. Sit down again, and let us finish our meal I shall sit between you, and then neither of you can blame the other Niels was too far away to hear their talk, but from their gestures he could guess what was happening, And thought it good fun.
